title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title: DevOps Engineer (0\-1Years)**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a motivated and talented DevOps Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with our development and operations teams to build and maintain our cloud\-based infrastructure and help automate our software development and deployment processes.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

· Manage Domain / Hosting / Email solutions for our client.

· Need you to take care of internal office Network / Server / Assets etc.

· Installation of the softwares like apache, nginx, Basic PHP, JAVA, NodeJs, React Js, Angular JS etc.

· Work with the development team to design and implement infrastructure solutions for new and existing applications.

· Set up and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS and Azure.

· Help automate the software development and deployment processes using tools like Jenkins and Gitlab.

· Build and maintain monitoring and alerting systems to ensure the reliability and availability of our applications and services using tools like Grafana, Prometheus and Zabbix or any other.

· Continuously identify and implement improvements to our infrastructure and processes.

· Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve queries.

· Coordinate with clients to understand their query and troubleshoot the same.

**Requirements:**

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

· Understanding of Linux operating systems, command line interface (CLI) and networking fundamentals.

· Familiarity with cloud computing platforms like AWS and Azure.

· Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Python or Java.

· Experience with containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes is a plus.

· Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot issues in a timely manner.

· Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Work Location: In person

description:
**Role description**  


Job Title: Platform Engineer – AWS \& Databricks Overview

We are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to design, automate, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure and data platforms on AWS and Databricks. This role requires strong expertise in cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), platform governance, automation, and DevOps practices to deliver secure, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions.



The ideal candidate will collaborate with data engineering, analytics, security, and business teams to build and maintain modern cloud platform capabilities that support enterprise data and analytics workloads.


Key Responsibilities
### **Cloud Platform Engineering**


* Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and platform services on AWS and Databricks.
* Build scalable, secure, and highly available environments that support data and analytics workloads.
* Ensure platform solutions align with security, governance, and operational best practices.

### **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**


* Develop and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and configuration management processes.
* Promote infrastructure standardisation and repeatable deployment patterns.

### **AWS Platform Management**


* Manage and support core AWS services including:
	+ Amazon S3
	+ IAM
	+ Lambda
	+ EC2
	+ KMS
	+ VPC
	+ API Gateway
	+ Route 53
	+ Secrets Manager
* Implement networking, security, and access management best practices across cloud environments.

### **Databricks Platform Administration**


* Provision and manage Databricks workspaces, compute resources, SQL Warehouses, and governance frameworks.
* Support data platform operations, performance optimisation, and access management.
* Implement governance controls to ensure secure and compliant platform usage.

### **DevOps \& Automation**


* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern Git\-based workflows.
* Automate deployment, configuration, and operational processes to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Support platform releases through robust DevOps practices.

### **Security, Governance \& Compliance**


* Implement cloud security best practices, including access controls, encryption, secrets management, and network security.
* Support governance, compliance, auditing, and risk management initiatives.
* Ensure cloud platforms meet organisational security and regulatory requirements.

### **Platform Reliability \& Monitoring**


* Monitor platform health, performance, and availability.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and platform\-related issues.
* Support observability, performance tuning, incident management, and operational excellence initiatives.

### **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Work closely with engineering, analytics, architecture, and business teams to deliver platform capabilities.
* Participate in technical discussions, solution reviews, and platform improvement initiatives.
* Communicate technical solutions and recommendations effectively to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications
### **Experience**


* 5\+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or related roles.
* Experience managing cloud\-native platforms in production environments.

### **Technical Skills**


* Strong expertise in AWS cloud services and platform engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks platform administration and governance.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or equivalent).
* Strong Python programming and automation skills.
* Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines.


Preferred Qualifications
* Experience with Databricks Workflows and platform automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and modern data platform architectures.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, and cloud cost optimisation practices.
* Exposure to AI/ML platform enablement and API integrations.
* Experience working in multi\-account AWS environments.
* Understanding of cloud financial governance and cost management frameworks.

Education
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Key Skills
* Databricks
* AWS Cloud Platform
* Terraform
* AWS CloudFormation
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Python
* CI/CD
* DevOps
* Cloud Security
* Platform Engineering


  

**Skills**  

Databricks, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Infrastructure as Code

title: Senior Associate - DevOps
description:
### **Description**

  

As a **Senior DevOps Engineer**, you will lead the design, evolution, and optimisation of the infrastructure, automation frameworks, and delivery pipelines that underpin reliable, secure, and scalable software delivery across the organisation. You will influence technical direction, drive DevOps maturity, and act as a key partner to engineering, architecture, security, and global delivery teams.
This role requires deep technical expertise, strong ownership, and the ability to guide teams in adopting modern engineering and operational best practices. You will champion automation, observability, and cloud‑native excellence, ensuring platforms are resilient, performant, and able to scale with business demands.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design and enhancement of enterprise‑grade CI/CD pipelines supporting automated build, test, security, and deployment workflows.
* Ensure pipelines are highly scalable, secure, and optimised for fast, reliable delivery across multiple products and environments.
* Collaborate with engineers and QA teams to embed quality gates, security scanning, and automated testing throughout the pipeline.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce manual interventions, increase deployment frequency, and enhance release confidence.
* Mentor engineers on best practices in release automation, branching strategies, and pipeline optimisation.
* Architect, provision, and maintain cloud environments (preferably Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform, ARM, or Bicep.
* Oversee the stability, performance, and scalability of development, staging, and production environments.
* Implement robust cloud architecture aligned with security, cost‑optimisation, and operational standards.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex infrastructure or environment‑related incidents in collaboration with global teams.
* Guide the adoption of cloud‑native patterns, automation, and modern infrastructure practices.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

5–8\+ years in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or SRE, ideally within complex enterprise environments.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).  

Advanced experience with CI/CD technologies (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).  

Strong hands‑on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud‑native services.  

Solid proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred; ARM/Bicep advantageous).  

Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, PowerShell, Python).  

Deep understanding of containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).  

Strong knowledge of Agile delivery and DevOps/SRE best practices.  

Exceptional troubleshooting, analytical, and incident‑resolution capabilities.
Excellent communication skills, comfortable working with global and senior stakeholders.### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your Role**
-------------


* Design, build, and manage end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
* Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and management using Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
* Deploy, manage, and support containerized applications on Kubernetes (AKS) and Docker.
* Implement secure, scalable, and highly available Azure cloud solutions and DevSecOps practices.
* Monitor production environments, provide incident support, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvements.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* **CI/CD \& DevOps:** Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, YAML Pipelines, Git, Release Management.
* **Infrastructure Automation:** Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Environment Provisioning.
* **Container \& Orchestration:** Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Helm, Ingress Controllers, Autoscaling.
* **Azure Cloud:** AKS, ACR, Key Vault, App Services, Storage Accounts, Azure Monitor.
* **Automation \& Monitoring:** PowerShell, Bash, Python, Linux Administration, SonarQube, Veracode, Prometheus, Grafana.
**What you'll love about working here**
---------------------------------------


* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top\-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting\-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: ML Ops Engineer - DSA
description:
vConstruct, a part of DPR Construction, is transforming the construction industry through digital engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, BIM, Data Engineering, and advanced analytics. We build AI\-powered solutions that improve productivity, safety, quality, planning, and decision\-making across the construction lifecycle.
 AI Observability (ML Ops Engineer)
We are looking for a AI Observability Engineer to join our team and contribute to developing robust data solutions to support our Machine Learning, Data Science, Data Engineering and Software Engineering. **Position Overview**
The AI Observability Engineer will be instrumental in implementation of scalable, cloud\-native solutions to meet the growing needs of our Data \& Development team. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to abstract complexity and create reusable, scalable patterns that accelerate development. The AI Observability Engineer will build and maintain a robust framework to ensure the reliability and maintainability of DPR Construction's complex AI systems.
**Responsibilities*** Standardize observability practices across AI/ML and other development teams including logging, metrics, tracing, and model performance monitoring, ingesting data from multiple platforms
* Lead hands\-on implementation of automation\-first DevOps and MLOps practices, enabling infrastructure\-as\-code and consistent, repeatable environment provisioning
* Design and manage intelligent DataOps pipelines with automated data quality monitoring and anomaly detection
* Deploy, maintain and monitor containerized ML workloads
* Extend existing CI/CD pipelines to support automated infrastructure changes and ML workflows
* Implement AI\-driven data validation, schema and concept drift detection and metadata management.
* Establish governance frameworks for AI systems, including bias detection, explainability, and auditability
* Extend existing Azure RBAC strategy by automating role and permission management to reduce manual intervention
* Develop automated test suites for model performance, regression, edge cases and bias validation
* Monitor model KPIs (accuracy, precision, recall, latency, calibration)
* Ensure reproducability of experiments and production models
* Act as a technical point of contact for DevOps and MLOps practices, developing reusable patterns, documentation, and proof\-of\-concepts to drive adoption


**Qualifications*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 8\-10 years of experience in DevOps, MLOps, Data Engineering, Software Engineering or Site Reliability Engineering
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and experience working with at least one major cloud provider, preferably Azure
* Proficiency in at least one objected\-oriented programming language, preferably python with hands\-on experience in ml frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit\-learn


**Why Join vConstruct?**
At vConstruct, you'll work on AI solutions that solve real\-world construction challenges at global scale. You'll collaborate with experts in AI, BIM, digital construction, and engineering to build cutting\-edge Computer Vision systems that shape the future of construction technology. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern vision foundation models, multimodal AI, and production\-grade machine learning while creating measurable impact across one of the world's largest industries. **About vConstruct :**
vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling and Construction Technology services geared towards construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction.  

VConstruct has 100\+ team members working on Software Development, Data Analytics, Data Engineering and AI/ML. We have matured Data Science practice and growing at accelerated pace. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com **About DPR Construction:**
DPR Construction is a national commercial general contractor and construction manager specializing in technically challenging and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, biopharmaceutical, corporate office, and higher education and healthcare markets. With the purpose of building great things, great teams, great buildings, great relationships—DPR is a truly great company. For more information, please visit www.dpr.com
